trava.texto: Type the app password to see your messages.
trava.restam: Wrong password. {n} tries left before everything is erased from this device.

criar.texto: It locks your messages when the app sits idle or goes to the background. It is not your account password and never leaves this device. Use at least 6 characters.
criar.diferentes: The two passwords do not match.

entrar.texto: Sign in with your Alumia account. The chat runs inside this app: no key code comes from the website.
entrar.nao_confirmado: Confirm your email before signing in.
entrar.falha: Could not sign in now. Check the connection and try again.
entrar.semFator: This account has no authenticator app yet. Set it up on the website and come back.

ajustes.disfarce: Name and icon on the home screen
ajustes.disfarceTexto: Switch to a common name. The app stays the same; the change may take a few seconds to show.
ajustes.apagarAviso: Warning: when on, anyone who types the wrong app password this many times erases EVERYTHING on this device (messages, keys and the account in this app), with no way back. A child or someone fiddling with your phone may erase it by accident. Keep the chat backup first.
ajustes.apagarConfirmar: I understand the warning and want to turn it on

cofres.software: Software only: this device has no hardware vault.

link.pergunta: Open this address outside the app?
link.aviso: No link opens by itself: check the address first.

apagado: Everything was erased from this device.
sem_webview: To open the conversations, this device needs an updated Android System WebView (version 137 or newer). Update it from the device app store and open the app again.
